title: Heapify After an Update
description: nums is a valid min-heap stored as an array (children of i sit at 2i+1 and 2i+2). Set nums[index] to val, restore the heap by sifting that element up or down, and return the array. Sift up swaps with the parent while the parent is strictly larger; sift down swaps with the smaller child (the left one on a tie) while that child is strictly smaller.

sourceTitle: Build heap from a given Array
title: Build a Min-Heap
description: Turn nums into a min-heap in place in O(n) by sifting down every non-leaf index from the last one back to 0, and return the array. Sift up swaps with the parent while the parent is strictly larger; sift down swaps with the smaller child (the left one on a tie) while that child is strictly smaller.

title: Implement a Min-Heap
description: Build MinHeap on an array. insert(x) appends and sifts up. extract() removes and returns the minimum (move the last element to the root and sift down), or -1 if empty. peek() returns the minimum or -1. changeKey(index, val) overwrites the array slot and sifts it into place. toArray() returns the current array. Sift up swaps with the parent while the parent is strictly larger; sift down swaps with the smaller child (the left one on a tie) while that child is strictly smaller.
constraints: changeKey is only called with a valid index.

title: Implement a Max-Heap
description: Build MaxHeap with the same operations as the min-heap version, but extract() and peek() work with the maximum. Sift up swaps with the parent while the parent is strictly smaller; sift down swaps with the larger child (the left one on a tie) while that child is strictly larger. extract() and peek() return -1 when empty.
constraints: changeKey is only called with a valid index.

sourceTitle: Check if an array represents a min heap
title: Is It a Min-Heap?
description: Return whether nums, read as a complete binary tree (children of i at 2i+1 and 2i+2), satisfies the min-heap property: every parent is less than or equal to its children.

sourceTitle: Convert Min Heap to Max Heap
title: Min-Heap to Max-Heap
description: nums is a min-heap. Rearrange it into a max-heap with a bottom-up build: sift down every non-leaf index from the last one back to 0, swapping with the larger child (left on a tie) while it is strictly larger. Return the array.

title: Heap Sort
description: Sort nums in ascending order in place with heap sort: build a max-heap, then repeatedly swap the root with the last unsorted slot and sift the new root down within the shrinking heap. Return the array.

sourceTitle: K-th Largest element in an array
title: Kth Largest Element
description: Return the kth largest value in nums (counting duplicates, so it is the kth value in descending order). Keep a min-heap of size k; its top is the answer.

sourceTitle: Kth largest element in a stream of running integers
title: Kth Largest in a Stream
description: Build KthLargest(k, nums). add(val) adds a value to the stream and returns the kth largest value seen so far. Every add call happens when at least k values exist. Keep a min-heap holding only the k largest.
